_doc: Hand-rolled admin checks in src/app/api still waiting to move onto requirePermission() / can() (#1571, story #1565).
Checked by scripts/check-authz.mjs (npm run check:authz). pending only shrinks: lower or delete an entry with  npm run check:authz -- --shrink  after converting a route; never add one.
allowed: a site that branches on the caller role for DATA SHAPE, not access — { count, reason }.

src/app/api/agendas/personalize/route.ts.reason: `audience: 'operator'` marks an admin outside the pair as operator AI use — a billing class (#1738), not an access decision; asking can() here would let a narrowed admin tier be billed as the pair

src/app/api/company/outreach/route.ts.reason: GET only picks which approval queue a decider sees (mentor/admin PENDING, mentee APPROVED); the rows any caller can reach come from outreachActorWhere(), not from this branch

src/app/api/invite/route.ts.reason: `role` here is the INVITED role from the request body: an ADMIN invitation takes an admin seat (#1752 quota) — data, not the caller's authority

src/app/api/register/route.ts.reason: `role` here is the role the invitation grants: accepting an ADMIN invitation takes an admin seat (#1752 quota); register has no caller session to authorize

src/app/api/weekly-reports/[id]/route.ts.reason: PATCH refuses the ADMIN role a write (admins only read weekly reports): it narrows access, never widens it.
